fusions.name: Kick the Hive
fusions.desc: Kicks a swarm loose that deals 11 poison damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, with a 60% chance to leave each [Poisoned] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on them spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, and you move 25% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Comb Robber
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. A darting bite deals 9 damage to the first enemy it meets and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Buzzing Halo
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 20% for 10 seconds. While it lasts, a swarm escort strikes your enemies for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Sugar Rush
fusions.desc: Each time you regain health, you also regain 3 stamina a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
